paper_cards.title: SceneRig: An Agentic System for Simulation-Ready 3D Scene Reconstruction from Single Images
paper_cards.data: 44 simulator-grounded scenes, 80-scene stability set, 100 real policy episodes and 25 replay demonstrations.
paper_cards.method: Agentic geometry/appearance reconstruction followed by edit-and-validate loops in a physics simulator.
paper_cards.task: Single-image reconstruction of editable, stable, simulation-ready robot workspaces.
paper_cards.novelty: Tests whether reconstructed scenes predict real policy outcomes and support unadapted trajectory replay.
paper_cards.evidence: Official page reports 100% all-object stability versus 10.0% for VIGA and 80% replay success versus 36% for SimFoundry.

claim_checks.claim: Official page reports 100% all-object stability versus 10.0% for VIGA and 80% replay success versus 36% for SimFoundry.
claim_checks.notes: Primary arXiv record and linked official artifact checked; results remain author-reported.

paper_cards.limitations: Fresh release; no independent reproduction was performed and cross-paper protocols are not assumed comparable.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Direct baseline and validation protocol for image-to-simulation reconstruction.

paper_cards.title: NeoWorld-3: From Pixels to Code-Defined Physical Worlds
paper_cards.data: Object- and scene-level reconstruction benchmarks plus real-sim-real robot transfer.
paper_cards.method: Coding agents use NeoSDK geometry/physics tools and NeoMCP APIs to iteratively edit executable programs.
paper_cards.task: Reconstruct code-defined physical objects and scenes from images.
paper_cards.novelty: Extends executable reconstruction from standalone articulated assets to compositional scenes with physical validation.
paper_cards.evidence: Primary abstract reports geometric/physical readiness evaluation and zero-shot dual-arm real-sim-real execution.

claim_checks.claim: Primary abstract reports geometric/physical readiness evaluation and zero-shot dual-arm real-sim-real execution.
claim_checks.notes: Primary arXiv record and linked official artifact checked; results remain author-reported.

paper_cards.limitations: Fresh release; no independent reproduction was performed and cross-paper protocols are not assumed comparable.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Potential executable-world compiler baseline; evidence/release maturity is not yet sufficient.

paper_cards.title: InfiniDream: Open-Ended Photorealistic 3D Worlds Through Procedural Generation
paper_cards.data: 100 object and 20 scene tasks with perceptual metrics and human preferences.
paper_cards.method: Symbolically constrained asset generation plus frustum-guided procedural world placement.
paper_cards.task: Text-to-editable procedural assets and large-scale 3D worlds.
paper_cards.novelty: Creates novel procedural asset types beyond fixed factories while retaining seed diversity.
paper_cards.evidence: Primary abstract reports controlled object/scene evaluation, diversity analysis and human preference study.

claim_checks.claim: Primary abstract reports controlled object/scene evaluation, diversity analysis and human preference study.
claim_checks.notes: Primary arXiv record and linked official artifact checked; results remain author-reported.

paper_cards.limitations: Fresh release; no independent reproduction was performed and cross-paper protocols are not assumed comparable.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Useful PCG reference, but direct embodied simulator use remains unproven.

paper_cards.title: UniFlowWAM: A Unified World-Action Model with Visual Semantics and 4D Geometry
paper_cards.data: 214,443 episodes, RoboCasa-GR1, LIBERO/Plus and four real bimanual tasks.
paper_cards.method: Three-expert diffusion transformer jointly models future visual features, scene flow and actions under ten role assignments.
paper_cards.task: Unified action, forward/inverse dynamics and 4D flow prediction.
paper_cards.novelty: Makes scene flow a co-equal supervised modality inside a unified policy rather than an auxiliary module.
paper_cards.evidence: Official page reports 56.4% mean RoboCasa-GR1 and 87.0% real-robot success versus 68.5% strongest baseline.

claim_checks.claim: Official page reports 56.4% mean RoboCasa-GR1 and 87.0% real-robot success versus 68.5% strongest baseline.
claim_checks.notes: Primary arXiv record and linked official artifact checked; results remain author-reported.

paper_cards.limitations: Fresh release; no independent reproduction was performed and cross-paper protocols are not assumed comparable.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Direct 4D WAM baseline, but paper and code were still marked coming soon.

paper_cards.title: PhysiCalWorld: In-Context Physics Calibration for World Models
paper_cards.data: Four simulated environments varying mass, mass distribution, joint damping, friction and air drag.
paper_cards.method: An interaction context encoder creates a reusable physics descriptor token for an action-conditioned world model.
paper_cards.task: Calibrate future rollouts to instance-specific hidden physics at test time.
paper_cards.novelty: Performs label-free in-context calibration without fine-tuning or analytical system identification.
paper_cards.evidence: Official page documents four physics environments and reports improved prediction and planning after calibration.

claim_checks.claim: Official page documents four physics environments and reports improved prediction and planning after calibration.
claim_checks.notes: Primary arXiv record and linked official artifact checked; results remain author-reported.

paper_cards.limitations: Fresh release; no independent reproduction was performed and cross-paper protocols are not assumed comparable.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Direct baseline for hidden-dynamics adaptation and rollout validation.

paper_cards.title: Sensorimotor Alignment: A Platonic Proxy for Embodied Policy Success
paper_cards.data: Twelve VLAs on SimplerEnv plus WAM, real-robot and frozen-backbone analyses.
paper_cards.method: Training-free neighborhood-overlap metric compares sensory representation geometry with end-effector trajectory geometry.
paper_cards.task: Offline screening and diagnosis of embodied policies and candidate backbones.
paper_cards.novelty: Introduces sensorimotor alignment as an inexpensive representation-level proxy for closed-loop success.
paper_cards.evidence: Official project page reports Pearson r=0.717 across 12 VLAs on SimplerEnv and releases code.

claim_checks.claim: Official project page reports Pearson r=0.717 across 12 VLAs on SimplerEnv and releases code.
claim_checks.notes: Primary arXiv record and linked official artifact checked; results remain author-reported.

paper_cards.limitations: Fresh release; no independent reproduction was performed and cross-paper protocols are not assumed comparable.
paper_cards.project_relevance: A direct pre-rollout validator for prioritizing VLA/WAM baselines and backbone candidates.

paper_cards.title: PhysTrace: Interpretable Temporal Evaluation of Physical Consistency in Video Generative Models
paper_cards.data: IntPhys2 plus new interval annotations for solidity, permanence, immutability and continuity.
paper_cards.method: History-conditioned expected events are aligned with overlapping observed video windows to localize violations.
paper_cards.task: Temporal localization and explanation of physical-consistency failures in generated video.
paper_cards.novelty: Moves beyond scalar plausibility to time-localized, interpretable physical violations and releases annotations/code.
paper_cards.evidence: Primary paper reports up to 70.7% hit rate; official repository includes evaluator, web demo and IntPhys2-Timing annotations.

claim_checks.claim: Primary paper reports up to 70.7% hit rate; official repository includes evaluator, web demo and IntPhys2-Timing annotations.
claim_checks.notes: Primary arXiv record and linked official artifact checked; results remain author-reported.

paper_cards.limitations: Fresh release; no independent reproduction was performed and cross-paper protocols are not assumed comparable.
paper_cards.project_relevance: A direct validator for generated world-model rollouts and reconstruction trajectories.

paper_cards.title: RoboJudge: Multimodal Language Models as Judges for Embodied Video Generation
paper_cards.data: 800 benchmark videos from 8 corpora/10 generators and 12,351 training videos with human-verified scores.
paper_cards.method: Benchmark plus a 9B MLLM judge trained with supervised learning and reinforcement learning.
paper_cards.task: Judge physical adherence and instruction alignment of generated embodied videos.
paper_cards.novelty: Systematically validates judge-human agreement for embodied rollouts and releases a specialized training/evaluation bundle.
paper_cards.evidence: Primary paper reports r=0.719 and +0.089 over the strongest proprietary baseline; official reviewer bundle exposes labels, predictions, prompts and checkpoint links.

claim_checks.claim: Primary paper reports r=0.719 and +0.089 over the strongest proprietary baseline; official reviewer bundle exposes labels, predictions, prompts and checkpoint links.
claim_checks.notes: Primary arXiv record and linked official artifact checked; results remain author-reported.

paper_cards.limitations: Fresh release; no independent reproduction was performed and cross-paper protocols are not assumed comparable.
paper_cards.project_relevance: A direct automated evaluator for candidate embodied-video/world-model rollouts.

paper_cards.title: AutoPhyX: Automatic Text-Condition Physics Property Generation
paper_cards.data: Part-controllable generated 3D assets paired with text and spatially varying physical parameters.
paper_cards.method: Cross-modal modulation predicts voxel physical-property fields compatible with multiple 3D representations.
paper_cards.novelty: Addresses visual ambiguity in stiffness/material properties with explicit language conditioning.
paper_cards.evidence: Primary abstract reports feed-forward assignment and in-the-wild generalization across mesh/point/Gaussian/NeRF inputs.

claim_checks.claim: Primary abstract reports feed-forward assignment and in-the-wild generalization across mesh/point/Gaussian/NeRF inputs.
claim_checks.notes: Primary arXiv record and linked official artifact checked; results remain author-reported.

paper_cards.limitations: Fresh release; no independent reproduction was performed and cross-paper protocols are not assumed comparable.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Potential asset-property field generator, but no downstream simulator/task validation yet.

paper_cards.title: DRILL: Training World Models to Improve Policies, Not Predict Pixels
paper_cards.data: Five manipulation simulators and two VLA backbones.
paper_cards.method: Bilevel return-optimized world-model training through closed-form reweighting or meta-gradients.
paper_cards.task: Train imagined rollouts for policy improvement rather than next-frame fidelity.
paper_cards.novelty: Demonstrates that pixel error can anti-correlate with policy utility and optimizes the downstream return directly.
paper_cards.evidence: Primary abstract reports +13.1 success points over WMPO and +7.9 over RLVR-World.

claim_checks.claim: Primary abstract reports +13.1 success points over WMPO and +7.9 over RLVR-World.
claim_checks.notes: Primary arXiv record and linked official artifact checked; results remain author-reported.

paper_cards.limitations: Fresh release; no independent reproduction was performed and cross-paper protocols are not assumed comparable.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Direct policy-utility WAM baseline; release is needed for evidence strength 4.

paper_cards.title: PVBench: Quantifying Physical Plausibility in Video Generation with Object-Level Physical Measurements
paper_cards.data: 600 prompts and 46 dimensions across seven physical/semantic/perceptual domains.
paper_cards.method: Specialized vision estimators derive object-level pose, scale, normals, kinematics and conservation residuals.
paper_cards.task: Quantify physical plausibility of text/image-conditioned generated videos.
paper_cards.novelty: Replaces broad judge-only scores with object-level physical measurements and human calibration.
paper_cards.evidence: Primary abstract documents 600 prompts, 46 dimensions and human-alignment validation.

claim_checks.claim: Primary abstract documents 600 prompts, 46 dimensions and human-alignment validation.
claim_checks.notes: Primary arXiv record and linked official artifact checked; results remain author-reported.

paper_cards.limitations: Fresh release; no independent reproduction was performed and cross-paper protocols are not assumed comparable.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Direct validator candidate, pending the promised public benchmark release.
